title: SafetyState
description: Safety-only sample: e-stop, deadman, mode, and link, plus identity. A schema-valid sample is not permission to skip the producer safety gate. Missing safety fields are invalid and must not be treated as a permit.

deadman.description: Operator deadman permit. True only while the deadman control is asserted. False is not a permit. Omitting the field is invalid and must not be read as true.
